name: Love Charm
source:
Together with your best friend Nina and three potential love interests, you’re drawn into a journey where each character holds a unique past, hidden motives, and secrets waiting to be unveiled. But beware: the necklace you’ve inherited harbors a power that can both heal and harm. Every decision you make can lead you closer to a happy ending—or a darker fate.

[From [url=https://lovecharm.itch.io/lovecharm]Itch.io[/url]]
